solution.name: Markstrata - Markdown Web Part for SharePoint Online

shortDescription.default: Markdown renderer for SharePoint with GitHub, Obsidian and VS Code themes

longDescription.default: Renders markdown from SharePoint libraries, URLs or inline content with readable, faithful themes modelled on GitHub, Obsidian and VS Code - including proper code block contrast, GitHub alerts and Obsidian callouts, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math and a table of contents.

features.title: Markstrata
features.description: Activates the Markstrata markdown web part.
